Here is the rate breakdown

July: AED 7,000 (30 nights each month)
August: AED 7,000 (30 nights each month)
September: AED 8,000 (30 nights each month)

If you would like us to block the unit until September, you may either pay the full last month amount of AED 8,000 in advance, or a partial advance payment of AED 4,000 to secure the unit for you.
